tool_input.body:
## Summary

The four behavior fixes specified by the Z-spec gap program (#530), each implemented against its merged spec via an ethos mission (m-2026-09-21-002…005, all closed pass by independent evaluators):

- **ethos-vaib** — path canonicalization preserves the absolute/relative distinction (`splitSegments` returns an absoluteness flag; `CanonicalPath("/docs/x.md") != CanonicalPath("docs/x.md")`; containment requires flag agreement), plus the review-round extensions: Windows drive-letter absolutes, `pathAllowed` resolving absolute in-repo targets against the repo root (`resolve.FindRepoRoot`, degrading to pre-fix behavior when no root resolves), and the `..`-prefix idiom fix. Per `docs/spec-writeset-admission.tex`; the spec gained an Implementation note recording the deliberate flag-equality widening.
- **ethos-fhns** — `Store.Update` gains the terminal-state guard every other mutating operation has; a forged caller-side status cannot resurrect a closed mission. The sibling open→closed forge gap the evaluator demonstrated is filed as **ethos-w1ii**; the spec's divergence paragraph is amended to state the remaining gap precisely.
- **ethos-8ady** — all six lint coverage heuristics (H1–H5, H7) now use the path-semantic containment primitive instead of literal string comparison; `docs/**` covers what it authorizes.
- **ethos-yf6n** — the empty-MISSION_ID verifier-gate skip is loud: a diagnostic when the spawn handle is an open mission's evaluator, an explicit "cannot determine" variant on store faults (never silence), delivered via the hook's `systemMessage` and the spawn's context (stderr alone is deployment-silent — the hook scripts redirect it into `hook-errors.log`). Gating unchanged per the bead's triage.

## Verification playbook

- `make check` green end-to-end at HEAD (includes the fuzz gate over all five Z specs).
- Independent mission evaluators (rsc ×3, mdm ×1) re-ran tests and re-verified claims per mission; the Update evaluator empirically demonstrated the residual forge gap with a standalone program (filed, not hidden).
- Three seeded local review agents on the full diff + a re-verification pass: 9 findings across the rounds, every one fixed and re-verified (repo-root fallback widening, drive-letter spelling, silent-scan suppression, uncertainty degradation, channel reroute, two residual lint literals, dotdot idiom, doc-comment accuracy).
- **Live Phase-3 observations through real entry points**: (1) audit records confirm production `Write`/`Edit` `file_path` payloads are absolute (`<repo>/…`, `~/…` redacted forms) — the normalization targets real payloads; (2) with the fixed binary installed, an unnamed `rsc` probe spawned against an open mission naming rsc as evaluator received the diagnostic **verbatim** in its context via the SubagentStart hook; the quiet path stayed quiet.
- The probe pair also exposed a harness-integration gap outside this PR's scope, filed as **ethos-ivec** (P2): named spawns receive the spawn NAME as `agent_type`, so agent_type-keyed hook logic (verifier isolation, persona injection, this diagnostic) misses them.

Beads: closes ethos-vaib, ethos-fhns, ethos-8ady, ethos-yf6n. Filed during this work: ethos-w1ii, ethos-ivec.
